drop.hint: Drop an .html file to reopen the processus

cell.codePlaceholder: Write some code, or a prompt on the left

preview.title: Preview

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Service used to generate the code from the prompts.
settings.keysNote: Keys stay in this browser and only go through the local server.
settings.language.note: Language of the interface, the examples and the comments in generated code. Changing it reloads the page.
settings.adminNote: Publishes a processus to src/examples/ on GitHub (with automatic FR ↔ EN translation). Shortcut: Ctrl + M then S, or Shift/Alt + click on Download.
publish.notSaved: This processus is not a published example.
publish.confirmDelete: Permanently remove the example “{title}” from GitHub?
publish.tokenPrompt: GitHub token (Personal Access Token with “repo” scope):
publish.titlePrompt: Title of the processus to publish:
provider.lmstudio.note: Local, on this computer · no key
provider.openrouter.label: Free models
llm.unreachable: Can't reach LM Studio. Start its local server (port 1234) and load a model.
llm.unreachableWeb: Can't reach LM Studio. Start its server (port 1234), load a model and turn on “Enable CORS” in the server settings. If the browser blocks local network access: site settings icon (left of the address bar) → “Local network” → “Allow”, then reload the page.
llm.localDenied: The browser is blocking local network access. Site settings icon (left of the address bar) → “Local network” → “Allow”, then reload the page.
llm.noProxy: The {baseUrl} proxy isn't running: restart “npm run dev” to load vite.config.js.
llm.noKey: {name}: add your API key in Settings (⚙︎ icon).
llm.noModel: No model available in LM Studio.
llm.hint.400: request rejected (invalid API key or model?)
llm.hint.401: invalid or missing API key (see Settings)
llm.hint.429: usage limit reached, try again in a moment
